seed.description: a 64- or 32-bit integer used as the value of the key.
constraints: must be a valid int or ArrayLike

impl.description: optional string specifying the PRNG implementation (e.g. ``'threefry2x32'``)

output.description: A PRNG key, consumable by random functions as well as ``split`` and ``fold_in``.

constraints: PRNGSpecDesc must be a valid PRNG implementation string or None
jax_default_prng_impl config flag determines the default PRNG implementation
